iconicAnchor.label: Structured full-text biomedical journal article
iconicAnchor.creatorOrTradition: Scholarly publishers, researchers, and the National Library of Medicine
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The preserved article exposes the complete scholarly apparatus—title, authorship, abstract, sections, figures, citations, and references—needed to distinguish an academic journal from merely dense editorial typography.

sources.title: Art of reading a journal article: Methodically and effectively
sources.publisher: National Library of Medicine, PubMed Central
supports: The full-text record demonstrates machine-readable and reader-visible hierarchy across article metadata, sections, references, and supporting material.
It supports depicting a complete research article rather than decorative columns and equations.

sources.title: Ten simple rules for structuring papers
sources.publisher: National Library of Medicine, PubMed Central
supports: The article provides a second real example of abstract, sectional prose, tables or figures, citations, and bibliography working as one reading system.
The accessible record supports the distinction between scholarly publication structure and institutional marketing.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches article structure, abstract block, citations footnotes, figures tables, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/academic-journal/generated-lead.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
